name: Cathode Ray Volumetric Display
definition: A volumetric display system that generates voxels by irradiating a fluorescent screen coated on a rotating plane with an electron beam.
summary: A Cathode Ray Volumetric Display generates true 3D voxels by using an electron beam to directly excite phosphor on a rotating screen, differing from optical systems by enabling high-intensity, glasses-free volumetric viewing.
